page_title: MAI 1-1 HAM | Mainz v Hamburger SV 20/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90+3' Kacper Potulski (Mainz) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper. Mainz earn a corner.
90+3' The resulting corner from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Hamburger SV was in an offside position.
90+2' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
90+1' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90+1' Kacper Potulski (Mainz) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Robin Braun ignores the protests.
89' The cross fools the defence and leaves Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post.
88' A substitution has been made. Miro Muheim goes off and Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger) comes on.
87' Merlin Polzin prepares a substitution. Ransford Konigsdorffer is replaced by Daniel Elfadli (Hamburger).
86' Substitution. Paul Nebel (Mainz) has come on for Jae-Sung Lee.
86' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) swings in a cross from the corner, but Daniel Batz reads it well and gathers the ball.
85' The attendance for today's match is 33305.
80' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
79' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
78' Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and Mainz manage to earn a corner.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) replaces Philip Otele.

73' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) found himself in a promising position. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made a decent save.
71' The Hamburger SV players are exchanging some short passes.
65' Merlin Polzin decides to make a substitution. Bakery Jatta will be replaced by William Mikelbrencis (Hamburger).
65' Substitution. Robert Glatzel makes his way off the pitch and Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) comes on as his replacement.
64' 1 - 1 Goal! The free-kick is fired in by Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) and the ball inadvertently flicks off a defender and spins into the net, leaving Daniel Batz stranded. 1:1.
63' Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Robin Braun blows for a foul. Hamburger SV are awarded a mid-range free kick.
61' Phillip Tietz (Mainz) does well to meet a cross from Sheraldo Becker, but he directs his shot just wide of the left post.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dominik Kohr departs the field of play to be replaced by Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz).
58' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) makes a really bad tackle on his opponent and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
57' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Nicolas Capaldo (Hamburger). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
56' Danny da Costa (Mainz) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Daniel Heuer Fernandes, who smothers the ball.
55' Philip Otele (Hamburger) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
53' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
53' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat. Mainz win a corner.
51' Flag goes up against Sheraldo Becker (Mainz) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
48' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is cleared to safety by the defence.
47' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Mainz have a corner.
46' Urs Fischer has made a change at the break. Sheraldo Becker has come on in place of Silas (Mainz).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
45+3' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
45+2' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+2' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45+1' Dominik Kohr (Mainz) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
45+1' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes intercepts the ball.

43' 1 - 0 Danny da Costa sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.
38' Danny da Costa (Mainz) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target.
37' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

37' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Mainz can continue in their attacking effort.
34' The foul by Miro Muheim (Hamburger) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Robin Braun.
33' The free kick is delivered by Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
32' Robin Braun blows his whistle. Philip Otele (Hamburger) commits a foul after dangerous play. Mainz have been awarded a free kick.
31' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) hits a piledriver from the edge of the box, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes acrobatically dives to stop the effort. Superb save!
29' A bullet header by Phillip Tietz (Mainz) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards over the crossbar.
27' Danny da Costa beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Nadiem Amiri (Mainz), who smashes a first-time shot high over the bar.

26' He should have scored! Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot aimed inside the left post is pretty weak and Daniel Batz makes an easy save.
23' Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

21' Daniel Batz is equal to the effort from the edge of the box by Warmed Omari (Hamburger), pushing the ball around the post to safety. Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) gets to the rebound and takes a shot which goes wide of the target.
20' Robert Glatzel (Hamburger) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the goal. Poor header!
17' A cross into the box finds the head of Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger) who steers it goalwards, but Daniel Batz manages to pull off a decent save to thwart him.
16' Hamburger SV control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
12' Silas (Mainz) sees a yellow card from Robin Braun after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
7' Miro Muheim (Hamburger) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
6' An attempted cross from Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) is cleared. Hamburger SV have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) unleashes a long-range free kick, but the goalkeeper does well to make a fine save.
3' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
2' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the corner.
1' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Mainz will have the kick-off.
Today's kick-off has been delayed due to heavy traffic en route to the stadium.
Robin Braun got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
